_readme: Titles and meta descriptions for the hand-written pages, applied by tools/seo-pass.js.
Rules (the pass refuses to run if they are broken): title <= 60 characters with the
primary term first and the brand last; description <= 155 characters, written as a
sentence a buyer would click, containing only claims the page itself makes.
A page not listed here keeps whatever it already has. Only <title> and the meta

about.title: About TalbotIQ | AI Software Company in Kuala Lumpur
about.description: Talbotiq Technologies builds AI software from Kuala Lumpur: interview and recruitment tools, CRM, ERP, document and meeting tools, plus custom development.

contact.title: Contact TalbotIQ | Book a Demo or Talk to the Team
contact.description: Tell us about your goals and bottlenecks and our engineers come back with a roadmap, not a brochure. Kuala Lumpur based, reply within one business day.

products/ai-avatar-interview.title: Conversational AI Avatar Interview Software | TalbotIQ
products/ai-avatar-interview.description: An AI avatar conducts the interview and asks the fortieth candidate what it asked the first: no fatigue, no rapport bias, one rubric for every answer.

products/business-management-system.title: Business Management System (ERP) for SMEs | TalbotIQ
products/business-management-system.description: An ERP built around how an SME runs: quotation to order, delivery and invoice on one chain of records, with the money questions read off that same chain.

products/chat-interview.title: Chat Interview Software: Blind Text Assessments | TalbotIQ
products/chat-interview.description: Behavioural questions answered in text and assessed with no name, face or accent attached, with AI-generated answers detected as they arrive.

products/conversational-chat-interview.title: Conversational Chatbot Interview Software | TalbotIQ
products/conversational-chat-interview.description: An open-ended written interview with no clock and no answer key: a thin answer draws a follow-up, and how a candidate writes under a prompt is assessed.

products/document-management.title: Intelligent Document Management & Parsing | TalbotIQ
products/document-management.description: AI extraction reads business cards and receipts in any language, pulls every field, converts currencies and flags tampering, with a person confirming each.

products/mcq-rounds.title: MCQ Interview Software for Screening Rounds | TalbotIQ
products/mcq-rounds.description: Multiple-choice interview rounds with a declared answer set, so scoring is arithmetic rather than judgement, drawn from your own question banks.

products/mimic.title: Mimic: AI Interview Software for Every Candidate | TalbotIQ
products/mimic.description: Mimic interviews every applicant the day they apply, across chat, voice, AI video and a live round, and scores each answer on one rubric with evidence.

products/note-taker.title: AI Meeting Notes & Minute Taker Software | TalbotIQ
products/note-taker.description: Live transcript with real names, a recap the moment you stop, and every open promise carried into the next meeting. Nothing joins your call.

products/recorded-video-interview.title: Recorded Video Interview Software (Asynchronous) | TalbotIQ
products/recorded-video-interview.description: Set the questions once and every applicant answers the same ones, in their own time. No calendars, no time zones, no forty-slot scheduling exercise.

products/recruitment-software.title: Recruitment Software (ATS) for Teams & Agencies | TalbotIQ
products/recruitment-software.description: Recruitment software: seven modules on one licence and one database. Hire Mode for internal talent teams, Agency Mode for staffing firms billing clients.

products/sales-crm.title: Sales CRM: Pipeline, Invoices & Approvals | TalbotIQ
products/sales-crm.description: A sales CRM for the desk and the road: cards, receipts and meetings captured as photos and audio, a configurable pipeline, quote-to-cash and receivables.

products/task-manager.title: Task & Productivity Manager with AI Triage | TalbotIQ
products/task-manager.description: Paste the meeting notes and the task manager finds every commitment, creates the task, assigns the owner and sets the date, then reports whether it landed.

products/timed-qa.title: Timed Q&A Interview Software | TalbotIQ
products/timed-qa.description: Timed Q&A interview rounds with a visible per-question limit, so you measure what a candidate knows and how they structure it under pressure.

products/two-way-interview.title: Two-Way Live Interview Software | TalbotIQ
products/two-way-interview.description: Your interviewer, the candidate, and the rubric on screen. Recorded, transcribed and scored against the same criteria as the async rounds.

products/vawlt.title: Vawlt: Private AI Engine with PII Scrubbing | TalbotIQ
products/vawlt.description: The private AI engine behind TalbotIQ products: 27 of 33 AI tasks run on purpose-trained models on our own hardware, each declaring its data handling.

products/video-interview.title: Video Interview Software for Hiring Teams | TalbotIQ
products/video-interview.description: Video interview software: a recorded round every applicant can take the day they apply, scored on one rubric, each score linked to the moment it came from.

products/voice-interview.title: Voice Interview Software, No Camera Needed | TalbotIQ
products/voice-interview.description: Voice interviews any candidate can take on the phone they already have: no camera, no download, transcribed live and scored on one rubric like every round.

solutions/ai-agent-bot-development.title: AI Agent & Bot Development Services | TalbotIQ
solutions/ai-agent-bot-development.description: AI agent and bot development: agents that decompose a request, plan the steps, call the tools and hand back the decisions a person should make.

solutions/ai-strategy-consulting.title: AI Strategy & Consulting Services | TalbotIQ
solutions/ai-strategy-consulting.description: Bridging the gap between speculative AI trends and measurable ROI by replacing manual workflows with autonomous, high-impact agentic systems.

solutions/embedded-edge-ai.title: Embedded Edge AI Development | TalbotIQ
solutions/embedded-edge-ai.description: Embedded edge AI: vision and sensor fusion deployed on existing hardware for real-time operational intelligence, including agricultural use.

solutions/full-stack-ai-integration.title: Full Stack Development & AI Integration | TalbotIQ
solutions/full-stack-ai-integration.description: Full stack development and AI integration: scalable systems that connect modern applications with existing infrastructure, built for speed and reliability.
